entries.title: Psalms 87:1
segments: <<A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song.>>  His foundation is in the holy mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 87:2
segments: Jehovah loveth the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 87:3
segments: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 87:4
segments: I will make mention of  Rahab and Babylon as among them that know me: Behold, Philistia, and Tyre, with  Ethiopia: This one was born there.

entries.title: Psalms 87:5
segments: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.

entries.title: Psalms 87:6
segments: Jehovah will count, when he writeth up the peoples, This one was born there. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 87:7
segments: They that sing as well as  they that dance [shall say], All my fountains are in thee.
